title: Pre-Analysis — Thermal Redesign of the Network Switch Line Card
abstract: Re-analysis of the network switch line card standard, carried out on the spares population after operators reported that a spare carrier reverted the port behaviour on the position it was fitted to.

sections.objective: Establish why a switch carrier taken from spares can revert the port initialisation behaviour on a converted aircraft, and what has to change in the spares process so that a line replaceable unit exchange does not undo an embodied modification.
sections.findings_summary: The cause was confirmed and the analysis validated the proposed fix. The configuration file is loaded into the switch and not into the aircraft, so a spare carrier arriving with the earlier file reverts that position. The software bulletin already says this in its material note but the note is at the end of a document most line engineers do not read at an exchange, and nothing in the removal or installation path checks it. Two items were confirmed: the software bulletin material note is correct but badly placed, and the maintenance task needs a step that reads the configuration file part number after any carrier exchange. The illustrated parts figure was found to list the card and spacer correctly after the revision that corrected the spacer quantity.
sections.next_steps: Add a configuration file verification step to the maintenance task after any carrier exchange. Move the spares warning from the material note into the accomplishment instructions of the software bulletin. No hardware change is required.

expected_findings.rationale: The spares warning is correct but sits in the material note, which is not read at a line replaceable unit exchange. The consequence is that an embodied aircraft can be reverted at one switch position without anyone noticing.
expected_findings.resolution: Move the warning into the accomplishment instructions and reference it from the maintenance task.

expected_findings.rationale: Nothing in the removal or installation path reads the configuration file part number, so a reverted position is invisible until the next message burst.
expected_findings.resolution: Add a verification step after any carrier exchange.

expected_non_findings.reason: Ranks highly on a semantic search for maintenance message handling and shares the avionics compartment, but it changes how messages are correlated once they exist and has nothing to do with the switch that generates them or with the spares path.

type_data.conclusion: Cause confirmed. Two documentation changes raised and no hardware change required.
